title: Measured componentwise SAT with Horn and logarithmic variable-deletion solvers
claims: ComponentwiseSAT lifts any measured guarded SAT solver to the exact language obtained by using that guard independently on each variable co-occurrence component.
CNFComponentFactorization shows that satisfiability is equivalent to absence of an empty clause and satisfiability of each variable component.
MeasuredCNFComponent extracts the exact canonical clause subsequence using the reference implication reachability routine.
ExactComponentwiseHybridSAT checks membership in P for the exact canonical SAT language whose components individually satisfy either Horn shape or a logarithmic 2-CNF deletion bound.
ComponentwiseHybridSATSearch recovers a sparse satisfying assignment of encoded length at most the original input size.
